title: This Bird's Feathers Carry the Same Poison as Dart Frogs

scenes.text: There's a bird in New Guinea with poison in its feathers.
Its skin and feathers carry batrachotoxin, the same poison found in poison dart frogs.
In a lab test, a few milligrams of its skin killed a mouse within minutes.
In 1989, a scientist touched his lips after handling one, and they went numb.
The bird doesn't make the poison. Scientists think it comes from the beetles it eats.
So yes: a bird that's poisonous to touch.

description:
There's a bird in New Guinea with poison in its feathers.
The hooded pitohui carries batrachotoxin, the same poison found in poison dart frogs.
Would you have touched it?
first_comment: A bird with poison in its feathers. What other animal should we check for secrets?
